# Element reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:ref` from the compiler sources. Do not edit by hand. -->

Regenerate with `npm run docs:ref`; `tests/registry.test.ts` fails when this file is stale.


## How to read this page

Lowercase names are built-in elements. A Capitalised name is either a `component` declared in a
`.pui` file or a host Dart widget constructor; components take the parameters they declare, host
widgets take whatever their constructor takes.

## Properties every element accepts

These are implemented by wrapping the element, so they work on both built-ins and component call sites.

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `padding` | `edge` | Inner spacing. 24, [vertical, horizontal], or [top, right, bottom, left]. → `Padding` |
| `margin` | `edge` | Outer spacing. → `Container.margin` |
| `width` | `number` | Fixed width in logical pixels. |
| `height` | `number` | Fixed height in logical pixels. |
| `size` | `number` | Fixed width and height. |
| `expand` | `bool` | Fill the available space along the parent’s main axis. → `Expanded` |
| `flex` | `number` | Flex factor used with expand. → `Expanded.flex` |
| `opacity` | `number` | Transparency, 0 to 1. → `Opacity` |
| `background` | `color` | Background fill colour. → `Container.color` |
| `bg` | `color` | Alias of background. |
| `radius` | `number` | Corner radius in logical pixels. → `BorderRadius.circular` |
| `border` | `number` | Border width; needs borderColor. → `Border.all` |
| `borderColor` | `color` | Border colour. |
| `align` | one of `topLeft`, `topCenter`, `topRight`, `centerLeft`, `center`, `centerRight`, `bottomLeft`, `bottomCenter`, `bottomRight` | Place the element within the space it is given. → `Align` |
| `main` | one of `start`, `end`, `center`, `between`, `around`, `evenly` | Main-axis distribution (column, row, scroll, list, wrap). → `MainAxisAlignment` |
| `cross` | one of `start`, `end`, `center`, `stretch`, `baseline` | Cross-axis alignment of children (column, row, wrap). → `CrossAxisAlignment` |
| `gap` | `number` | Space between children (column, row, wrap, list, scroll). |

## Gestures every element accepts

`tap`, `longTap`, `doubleTap`, `hover` — written as `on tap:` with an indented block of actions, like any native event.

## Layout

### `column`

Stacks children vertically.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

```plainui
column padding=16 gap=12:
    text "One"
    text "Two"
```

### `row`

Lays children out horizontally.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

```plainui
row gap=8 cross=center:
    image "logo.png" size=24
    text "PlainUI"
```

### `stack`

Paints children on top of each other.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fit` | one of `loose`, `expand` | How non-positioned children are sized. |
| `align` | one of `topLeft`, `topCenter`, `topRight`, `centerLeft`, `center`, `centerRight`, `bottomLeft`, `bottomCenter`, `bottomRight` | Where non-positioned children sit. |

```plainui
stack:
    image "cover.png" fit=cover
    text "Overlay" color=#ffffff
```

### `wrap`

Lays children out in lines that wrap at the edge.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | `number` | Space between children along a line. |
| `runGap` | `number` | Space between lines. |
| `main` | one of `start`, `end`, `center`, `between`, `around`, `evenly` | Alignment along each line. |

```plainui
wrap gap=8 runGap=8:
    text "one"
    text "two"
    text "three"
```

### `scroll`

A scrollable column of children.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | one of `vertical`, `horizontal` | Scroll direction. |
| `gap` | `number` | Space between children. |
| `padding` | `edge` | Inner spacing around the scrolling content. |

```plainui
scroll padding=16 gap=8:
    text "A"
    text "B"
```

### `list`

A ListView of children. Use a "for" node to repeat rows.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | one of `vertical`, `horizontal` | Scroll direction. |
| `gap` | `number` | Space between rows. |

```plainui
list gap=8:
    for item in items:
        text item
```

### `grid`

A fixed-column grid of children.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `number` | Number of columns. |
| `gap` | `number` | Space between cells. |

```plainui
grid columns=2 gap=8:
    text "a"
    text "b"
```

### `card`

A rounded surface with elevation.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `elevation` | `number` | Shadow depth. |
| `radius` | `number` | Corner radius. |
| `padding` | `edge` | Inner spacing. |
| `background` | `color` | Surface colour. |

```plainui
card padding=16 radius=12 elevation=2:
    text "Inside a card"
```

### `scaffold`

A page shell with an optional app bar.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** any number of children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | App bar title. Omit for no app bar. |
| `background` | `color` | Page background colour. |
| `centerTitle` | `bool` | Centre the app bar title. |

```plainui
scaffold title="Home":
    center:
        text "Hello"
```

### `center`

Centres a single child.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** exactly one child
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

```plainui
center:
    text "Centred"
```

### `align`

Aligns a single child within the available space.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** exactly one child
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

```plainui
align align=bottomRight:
    text "corner"
```

### `expanded`

Gives a child the remaining space in a row or column.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** exactly one child
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

```plainui
row:
    text "label"
    expanded:
        text "value"
```

### `safeArea`

Keeps content clear of notches and system bars.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** exactly one child
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bottom` | `bool` | Also avoid the bottom inset. |

```plainui
safeArea:
    text "Not under the notch"
```

### `spacer`

An empty flexible space.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

```plainui
row:
    text "left"
    spacer
    text "right"
```

## Content

### `text`

Displays a string.

- **Arguments:** `content: expr`
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `style` | `styleName` | Named text style: heading, display, body, caption, label, secondary, or one declared with "style". |
| `color` | `color` | Text colour. |
| `size` | `number` | Font size in logical pixels. |
| `weight` | one of `thin`, `light`, `regular`, `medium`, `semiBold`, `bold`, `black` | Font weight. |
| `textAlign` | one of `start`, `end`, `center`, `justify` | Horizontal alignment of the text itself. |
| `maxLines` | `number` | Maximum number of lines before overflowing. |
| `overflow` | one of `clip`, `fade`, `ellipsis`, `visible` | What to do with text that does not fit. |
| `letterSpacing` | `number` | Extra space between characters. |
| `lineHeight` | `number` | Line height multiplier. |
| `fontFamily` | `string` | Host font family name. |
| `italic` | `bool` | Render the text in italics. |

```plainui
text "Hello" style=heading
```

### `image`

Displays an asset image or a network image.

- **Arguments:** `src: expr`
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fit` | one of `contain`, `cover`, `fill`, `fitWidth`, `fitHeight`, `none`, `scaleDown` | How the image fills its box. |
| `radius` | `number` | Clip the image to rounded corners. |
| `semanticLabel` | `string` | Accessibility description. |

```plainui
image "assets/avatar.png" size=48 radius=24 fit=cover
```

### `icon`

Displays a Material icon.

- **Arguments:** `name: iconName`
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `number` | Icon size. |
| `color` | `color` | Icon colour. |

```plainui
icon search size=20 color=#666666
```

## Input

### `button`

A tappable action button.

- **Arguments:** `label: expr`
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover, focus, blur

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | one of `filled`, `outlined`, `text` | Visual style. |
| `color` | `color` | Accent colour. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | Render as disabled and ignore taps. |
| `fullWidth` | `bool` | Stretch to the available width. |
| `style` | `styleName` | Named text style: heading, display, body, caption, label, secondary, or one declared with "style". |
| `size` | `number` | Font size in logical pixels. |
| `weight` | one of `thin`, `light`, `regular`, `medium`, `semiBold`, `bold`, `black` | Font weight. |

```plainui
button "Save" variant=outlined:
    on tap:
        save()
```

### `input`

A text field. Bind it to state with bind=<name>.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** change, submit, focus, blur, tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bind` | `expr` | State variable to read and write (two-way binding). |
| `label` | `string` | Floating label. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Hint text shown when empty. |
| `secret` | `bool` | Obscure the text (passwords). |
| `multiline` | `bool` | Allow multiple lines. |
| `maxLines` | `number` | Maximum visible lines. |
| `keyboard` | one of `text`, `email`, `number`, `phone`, `url`, `multiline` | Which on-screen keyboard to show. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | Focus this field when the screen opens. |
| `helper` | `string` | Helper text under the field. |
| `counter` | `bool` | Show a character counter. |

```plainui
input bind=email label="Email" keyboard=email
```

### `toggle`

An on/off switch.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** change, tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bind` | `expr` | State variable to read and write. |
| `label` | `string` | Label beside the switch. |

```plainui
toggle bind=notifications label="Notifications"
```

### `checkbox`

A checkbox with an optional label.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** change, tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bind` | `expr` | State variable to read and write. |
| `label` | `string` | Label beside the box. |

```plainui
checkbox bind=remember label="Remember me"
```

### `slider`

A continuous value selector.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** change, tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bind` | `expr` | State variable to read and write. |
| `min` | `number` | Minimum value (default 0). |
| `max` | `number` | Maximum value (default 1). |
| `divisions` | `number` | Number of discrete stops. |

```plainui
slider bind=volume min=0 max=100 divisions=10
```

## Display

### `divider`

A one-pixel separator line.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `thickness` | `number` | Line thickness. |
| `color` | `color` | Line colour. |

```plainui
divider thickness=1 color=#e0e0e0
```

### `progress`

A progress indicator, determinate or spinning.

- **Arguments:** no arguments
- **Children:** no children
- **Events:** tap, longTap, doubleTap, hover

| Property | Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | Progress from 0 to 1. Omit for an indeterminate spinner. |
| `indeterminate` | `bool` | Force the spinning form. |
| `color` | `color` | Indicator colour. |

```plainui
progress indeterminate
```

## Text styles

Built in: `display`, `heading`, `subheading`, `body`, `caption`, `label`, `secondary`.

A `style` declaration adds one of your own:

```plainui
style price:
    size=20
    weight=bold
    color=#1d4ed8

screen Home:
    text "10 ETB" style=price
```

Properties allowed in a style declaration: `size`, `weight`, `color`, `fontFamily`, `letterSpacing`, `lineHeight`, `italic`.

`text`, `button` and `style` declarations all accept the same text properties, so a style can be
overridden at the point of use: `text "x" style=price size=12`.
